2. Combine all ingredients in a cocktail shaker with ice and shake until chilled.
3. Strain into the prepared coupe or cocktail glass.
4. Garnish with 3 drops of orange flower water.
ba-tequila-daisy.description: A Tequila Daisy cocktail recipe from one of Punch's Best New Bartenders fine-tunes the ratios of the classic drink.
ba-tequila-daisy.garnish: sugar (to rim the glass), orange flower water

ba-tequila-matador.method_text:
1. Combine all ingredients in a mixing tin and shake with shaved ice.
2. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
ba-tequila-matador.description: Trader Vic's Tequila Matador cocktail recipe makes a combination of tequila, pineapple juice and lime shaken with shaved ice and served up.

ba-tequila-old-fashioned.method_text: Stir with ice and strain into ice-filled rocks glass.
ba-tequila-old-fashioned.garnish: Garnish with orange peel squeezed over drink.

ba-tequila-spritz.method_text:
1. In a 750ml bottle, combine the tequila, Aperol, sweet vermouth and bitters. Cap the bottle securely, then shake well to mix. Store in the freezer.
2. To serve, pour into a wine glass filled halfway with ice cubes and an orange slice. Top with tonic water.
3. NOTEStarting with a full bottle Pour off 15 oz. (450ml). Makes 5 to 7 cocktails.
ba-tequila-spritz.description: For those times when it's just too hot to make an effort, Freezer Door Cocktails author J.M. Hirsch shared 75 cocktails that can be built right in the liquor bottle and stored in the freezer. His batched Tequila Spritz is especially perfect for poolside sipping. "This cocktail lives in a happy place somewhere between sangria and an Aperol Spritz," he writes. For those who prefer it without the tonic water, Hirsch suggests serving it in a coupe that's filled halfway with crushed ice.

ba-teton-tanya.method_text: Combine the ingredients in a mixing glass with ice and stir to chill. Strain into a rocks glass over a single large ice cube and garnish.
ba-teton-tanya.description: Rye whiskey spices up this take on the Boulevardier, which also shakes up tradition by using Cynar and Aperol for the bittersweet components.

ba-thad-voglers-el-presidente.method_text:
1. Stir and strain into a chilled stem glass.
2. Garnish with a lemon twist.
ba-thad-voglers-el-presidente.description: The Cuban classic cocktail recipe gets an update from Obispo bar owner Thad Vogler who swaps in bianco vermouth for the traditional dry.

ba-the-brave.method_text:
1. Combine the ingredients in a wine glass and gently swirl to combine.
2. Using an atomizer, spray 3 bursts of Angostura bitters on the drink’s surface. (Alternatively, add 3 drops of Angostura to the drink.)
3. Take a coin-size slice of orange peel and—while carefully holding a lit match slightly above and to the side of the drink’s surface—spray its oils through the flame and atop the drink.
ba-the-brave.description: A room-temperature cocktail with a split base of agave spirits, The Brave has been on Anvil’s menu with few interruptions since its debut in 2009.

ba-the-coffee-house.method_text:
1. Combine all ingredients in a mixing glass over ice and stir until chilled.
2. Strain into a rocks glass over a large ice cube.
3. Garnish with a long orange twist.
ba-the-coffee-house.description: An improved, coffee-inflected Old-Fashioned cocktail recipe from the 1930 recipe book, The Saloon in the Home or a Garland of Rumblossoms.

ba-the-cutter.method_text:
1. Combine all ingredients in a mixing tin and shake with ice.
2. Strain into a chilled coupe.
ba-the-cutter.description: This cocktail recipe is a riff on The Paper Airplane that swaps house-made Campari for Aperol and house Amer Picon for Nonino.

ba-the-dead-rabbit.method_text:
1. In a shaker, add all the ingredients.
2. Vigorously dry shake for 30 seconds (without ice).
3. Add a scoop of ice to the shaker and shake for another 30 seconds.
3. Double strain into a coupe.

Note: For the Halloween edition, add 2 bags of Celestial Raspberry tea during the steep for that spooky black color.
ba-the-dead-rabbit.description: Arbella in Chicago envisions a Halloween cocktail as a mezcal sour with the juicy sweetness of raspberry balanced by the bitterness of Cynar.

ba-the-doctors-orders.method_text: 1. Add all of the ingredients, except the dark rum, to a shaker with ice. Shake to chill, then strain into a glass over crushed ice. Float with the dark rum. Garnish.
ba-the-doctors-orders.description: Since summers in the South tend to be quite sultry, Dan Williams of The Darling Oyster Bar in Charleston and Savannah, wanted to create a refreshing tropical rum cocktail that's "easy to drink but still has the complexity and strength you expect from a great rum cocktail." He turned to the Royal Hawaiian Mai Tai for inspiration. The white rum and spiced rum blend is sweetened with fresh pineapple and orange juices and orgeat. For contrast and complexity, a float of dark rum is layered on the finished cocktail.

ba-the-end-of-the-road.method_text: Stir all ingredients cold on ice and strain into pre-chilled glass.
ba-the-end-of-the-road.description: McMillian’s “End of the Road” cocktail is just the sort of drink you would expect from the past, a simple equal parts combination of distinctive spirits that merge into something truly unique. The cocktail balances smoky Laphroaig scotch with bitter Campari and wildly herbal Chartreuse. It’s an unlikely blend with an unlikely ratio but wouldn’t you know, it’s perfectly balanced and delicious. It’s a sophisticated sipper, a gentleman’s nightcap, and features three ingredients easily found in most bars. Perhaps even found somewhere in the world, where puzzlers ponder, at the end of the road.

ba-the-flatliner.method_text:
1. Add all of the ingredients to a shaker with ice and shake to chill.
2. Fine-strain into the chilled glass.
3. Top the cocktail with cinnamon whipped cream and garnish.
ba-the-flatliner.description: For a decadent Espresso Martini-inspired cocktail, The National Telluride adds Irish cream to the coffee cocktail and garnishes with cinnamon whipped cream and a pizelle cookie. A touch of Grand Marnier gives it subtle bitter orange and vanilla notes.
ba-the-flatliner.garnish: Cinnamon whipped cream and a pizzelle cookie

ba-the-greenpoint.method_text:
1. Add all ingredients to a mixing glass.
2. Add ice and stir until chilled.
3. Strain into a coupe.
4. Garnish with a lemon twist.
ba-the-greenpoint.description: A spin on the Brooklyn, itself a twist on the Manhattan.

ba-the-infante.method_text:
1. Combine all ingredients in a cocktail shaker with ice and shake until chilled.
2. Strain into a rocks glass over a large ice cube.
ba-the-infante.description: The Infante, a Margarita riff that introduces aromatic orgeat and rose water, shows how far the cantina staple has traveled. Named after Mexican actor Pedro Infante, the recipe was created in New York City by Giuseppe González, a testament to the way that craft cocktail circles have adopted the refreshing classic and made it their own.

ba-the-last-chateau.method_text: Add first 4 ingredients to a shaker tin with a few ice cubes and whip shake. Double strain into a wine glass over ice. Top with Moscato and gently stir to combine.
ba-the-last-chateau.description: Inspired by the last Chateau built during the Renaissance, Chateau de Villandry, and everyone’s favorite monk-juice cocktail the Last Word. I combined a delicious Loire Valley Chenin Blanc white wine, sparkling and sweet Moscato, Green Chartreuse and a fairly heavy dose of Lime juice with the rose and citrus flavored Italicus to make a complex and delicious spritz that hopefully sends me to Miami to compete later this summer.

ba-the-last-rainstorm.method_text: Shake all ingredients with ice, then strain into a coupe.
ba-the-last-rainstorm.description:
Imagine: a view of a sandy beach shore peeking out between dense green vegetation and hovering tree canopies, the faint scent of salt from the sea suspended in the warm breeze, and that electrifying feeling of energy in the air right before a thunderstorm. You take a sip. Crisp. Cold. Tropical. Revitalizing. This is that drink.

Chartreuse is the dominant flavor, trailed by a comforting whisper of coconut aroma and the grassy & clean Copalli rum. When recreating, your choice of coconut rum will be pivotal in how the drink turns out; the best coconut rum I can recommend is the Hawaiian-made Koloa rum. More info on this rum can be found here but in short, it’s a fresh, natural, actual RUM that is scented with coconut and not a coconut LIQUEUR like many cloyingly sweet “coconut rums” tend to be.

This is dangerously easy-drinking for what it is, imbibe responsibly. Chartreuse = 55% Copalli rum = 42%. Koloa coconut rum = 40%.

ingredients.name: Green Chartreuse
ingredients.note: or other herbal liqueur such as Centum Herbis or Genepy

ba-the-last-spritz.method_text: 1. Add the first 3 ingredients to a Collins glass with ice. Top with soda water and garnish.
ba-the-last-spritz.description: Transforming the classic, equal-parts Last Word into a refreshing spritz, this recipe replaces gin and lengthens the drink with soda water. “It’s light, bright, and herbaceous, with a touch of sweetness from the cherry liqueur,” says Danny Webber, general manager at aperitivo bar Capri Club in LA’s Eagle Rock neighborhood. “It’s a great lighter cocktail for warm afternoons.”

ba-the-mahatma.method_text:
1. Pour the liquids into shaker with ice and shake hard for 10 seconds.
2. Express orange oil from an orange peel over a chilled coupe glass and discard.
3. Double strain into the coupe. 


 ## Editors note:

### Hibiscus Grenadine:
ba-the-mahatma.description: An homage to Martin "Mahatma" Lomasney, who received the first Ward Eight cocktail, this riff adds hibiscus-infused grenadine and orange oil.
ba-the-mahatma.garnish: dried roses and sprig of thyme

ba-the-mean-fiddler.method_text:
1. Combine all ingredients in a mixing glass with ice and stir for 30-45 seconds or approximately 60 revolutions.
2. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
3. Garnish with a dehydrated orange wheel and a skewered cherry.
ba-the-mean-fiddler.description: The Mean Fiddler is a bold and complex whisky cocktail created by the team at Dead Rabbit in New York. This drink stands out with its layered flavors, combining the smoky depth of Islay whisky with the smoothness of Irish whiskey. The addition of Green Chartreuse and sweet vermouth introduces rich botanical notes, while Campari brings a touch of bittersweet orange complexity. A hint of cinnamon syrup and Angostura bitters adds aromatic warmth, tying everything together into a harmonious, spirit-forward experience perfect for those seeking a robust and warming drink.

ba-the-mystical-one.method_text:
1. Combine the 3 sage leaves and the cinnamon syrup in a cocktail shaker and use a muddler to lightly crush the sage.
2. Add the lime juice and bourbon.
3. Add ice and shake until chilled.
4. Strain into a coupe and garnish with a sage leaf.
ba-the-mystical-one.description: This simple, holiday-ready rendition of a Whiskey Sour combines the one-two punch of sage and cinnamon alongside lime juice in place of lemon.

ba-the-old-man-and-the-sea.method_text:
1. In a shaker filled with ice, combine the rum, grapefruit juice, coconut water, and lime juice.
2. Shake well to combine and strain into a rocks glass filled with ice.
3. Sprinkle the salt over the drink.
ba-the-old-man-and-the-sea.description: Coconut water and a pinch of salt make Whitney Otawka's Hemingway Daiquiri riff a standout.

ba-the-perfect-bqe.method_text:
1. Add all ingredients to a mixing glass.
2. Add ice and stir until chilled.
3. Strain into a Nick & Nora glass.
4. Garnish with a cherry.
ba-the-perfect-bqe.description: This cocktail recipe, inspired by the iconic New York highway, is made with equal parts dry and sweet vermouth.

ba-the-second-marriage.method_text: Pour the ingredients into the rocks glass over the ice cube. Stir, then garnish with the orange peel.
ba-the-second-marriage.description: How can you not like this one? It all just works together. It would take someone who knows sherry to even begin exploring this path, and Mr. Greenbaum found a great destination for it. Cavaldos is becoming a favorite spirit of mine, because it has a nice flavor AND it is readily available. Maybe an inspiration for another article. The difficult part for most would be finding the right pedro ximenez sherry. If you can do that, the rest will fall right into place.

ba-the-st-germain-spritz.method_text:
1. Combine ingredients in a Collins glass over ice.
2. Stir.
ba-the-st-germain-spritz.description: The St-Germain Cocktail recipe is the classic spritz variation fueled by the iconic elderflower liqueur, Champagne and soda water.

ba-the-tartan-cocktail.method_text:
1. Combine all ingredients in a mixing glass.
2. Add ice and stir for 20-30 seconds.
3. Strain into a cocktail glass over a large ice cube.
4. Garnish with a dried rose bud and/or an orange twist.
ba-the-tartan-cocktail.description: The Tartan Cocktail is a rich, layered winter drink that balances warmth and complexity. It starts with a foundation of single malt Scotch whisky, its oak and caramel notes softened by sweet vermouth’s cacao and citrus. Drambuie adds honeyed depth, while Amaro Ramazzotti introduces bitter-sweet orange and anise, all harmonized by a touch of Angostura bitters. Served stirred over a large ice cube, it evolves on the palate—perfect for cozy evenings.

ba-the-turnbuckle.method_text:
1. Combine all the ingredients in a mixing tin filled with crushed ice and shake until chilled.
2. Pour contents of shaker into a double Old-Fashioned glass or tropical tiki glass.
3. Garnish with an orchid and a mint bouquet.
ba-the-turnbuckle.description: Bartender Jen Akin adds bitter Cynar amaro to her tiki-style cocktail, built on Jamaican rum, for added depth.

ba-the-wardays.method_text:
1. Combine all of the ingredients in a mixing glass.
2. Add ice and stir for 30-45 sec. or approx. 60 revolutions.
3. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
ba-the-wardays.description:
The Warday’s is an interesting booze filled cocktail with complex roots and I knew immediately I have to make one after listening to the VinePair’s Cocktail College episode with Eryn Reece.

As mentioned in the podcast, cocktail borrows elements from two sources: Alaska (gin and yellow Chartreuse) and Manhattan (aged spirit, in this case represented by Calvados and sweet vermouth). By blending these ingredients together, a delicious booze filled cocktail is brought to life.

Notes of aged apples and pears are brought by the Calvados and then enriched by the botanicals of sweet vermouth. Gin contributes a healthy dose of juniper as well as a significant bite of alcohol. Final, modest, addition of yellow Chartreuse introduces a lot more herbal and botanical complexity as well as sweetness to the mix, nicely finishing the cocktail.

The Warday’s is a must try for seasoned cocktail enthusiasts. Rich, complex and delicious to the very last drop.

ba-the-west-8th.method_text: Muddle the mint and cucumber in a mixing tin. Add ice, vodka, lemon juice and simple syrup and shake to chill. Strain into a chilled coupe and top with the soda.
ba-the-west-8th.description: One of the bestsellers at Analogue in New York City, the West 8th is a Southside cocktail riff with cucumber and vodka.

ba-thief-of-hearts.method_text:
1. Stir all of the ingredients (except the peaty scotch) with ice, then strain into a chilled coupe.
2. Float a cucumber slice on top of the drink, and top with 3 drops of the peaty scotch.
ba-thief-of-hearts.description: Emily Mistell describes this winter cocktail, named for a 1984 erotic drama, as an elegant Manhattan riff with seductive aromatics.

ba-three-of-a-kind.method_text:
1. Stir all of the ingredients with ice
2. Strain into a glass filled with fresh ice
ba-three-of-a-kind.description: At Bar Cleeta in Bentonville, Arkansas, the appeal of Italian flavors led to the creation of this simple combo. “Though assertively spirit-forward, the maraschino and Cocchi Americano provide a smooth, lush base for the London dry gin,” says partner and beverage director Weisi Basore. “It’s quickly become a guest and staff favorite, for its complexity and aperitivo vibes."

ba-thunderbird.method_text:
1. Combine all ingredients, except club soda, in a mixing tin and shake with ice.
2. Strain into a Collins glass over ice.
3. Top with club soda.
4. Garnish with orange wheel.
ba-thunderbird.description: At Philadelphia's Zahav, this gin fizz variation strikes an appealing balance between citrus-first refresher and creamy, sweet dessert drink.

ba-thyme-after-thyme.method_text:
1. Shake all of the ingredients together in a shaker with ice
2. Strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice.
ba-thyme-after-thyme.description: This dead simple gin cocktail from Charleston blends the slightly bitter and herbaceous notes of Cocchi Americano with tart grapefruit.

ba-ti-punch.method_text:
1. Slice half a lime into wedges
2. Muddle limes and syrup in a rocks glass
3. Add 2-3 pieces of ice and stir until melted
ba-ti-punch.description: This Caribbean favorite is the laid back cousin to the daiquiri. Kick your feet up with the 'Ti Punch.

ingredients.name: Lime
ingredients.note: half-dollar-sized lime coin with some flesh on it

ba-ti-punch-highball.method_text:
1. In a highball glass, add the lime coin and muddle it to express the oils.
2. Add the sugar syrup, rum and 4 ice cubes and stir for a few seconds.
3. Add the coconut water and tonic water, then give one quick stir to integrate the ingredients.
ba-ti-punch-highball.description: Paul McGee stretches the classic Ti' Punch into a highball-like format with the addition of coconut water and tonic.

ba-tia-mia.method_text:
1. Add all ingredients into a shaker with ice and shake until well chilled.
2. Strain into a large rocks glass over crushed or pebbled ice.
3. Garnish with lime wheel, mint sprig and orchid (optional).
ba-tia-mia.description: This smoky twist on a Mai Tai from bartender Ivy Mix combines Jamaican rum with mezcal, orange curaçao, orgeat, and fresh lime juice.

ba-tigers-claw.method_text:
1. Add all ingredients to a shaker and shake with ice cubes.
2. Pour into a Collins glass.
3. Garnish with an orange half slice and mint sprig.
ba-tigers-claw.description: Tiger’s Claw is an easy tropical cocktail recipe made with reposado tequila, pineapple, lime, coffee liqueur and orange bitters.

ba-toby-cecchinis-gin-tonic.method_text:
1. Clean well a fat, fresh lime. Cut in half and juice both halves, setting the juice aside for another use. Julienne the spent hulls into thin strips and put into a small mixing tin or glass. Add gin and muddle well for a minute or so.
2. In a large highball glass half-filled with ice, pour the tonic water carefully at a slant, so as to not disturb the effervescence, and slip a straw down the side of the glass now.
3. Strain the gin-lime mixture over a spoon onto the top, so that it floats. With tongs or a spoon, garnish atop with the julienned strips of lime. Present as such, but mix lightly before drinking.


 ## Editors note:

This may seem a stiff pour, but in maceration the juiced hulls will actually soak up a significant cut of the gin—up to 3/4 ounce—and can leave the drink wan if not fortified a touch.
ba-toby-cecchinis-gin-tonic.description: The best Gin and Tonic cocktail recipe, which won our blind tasting of the drink, combines Tanqueray gin, tonic water and julienned lime.

ba-tom-macys-gimlet.method_text:
1. Cut a lime in half, then cut one half into quarters.
2. Muddle the limes in simple syrup.
3. Add lime juice and gin.
4. Shake and fine strain into a coupe.
ba-tom-macys-gimlet.description: Tom Macy's Gimlet cocktail recipe is simple: two ounces of gin, three-quarters of an ounce of simple syrup and half an ounce of lime juice.

ba-tonic-rickey.method_text:
1. In a lowball glass filled with ice, add the lime juice and simple syrup. Stir to combine.
2. Slowly stir in the tonic water and seltzer water.
3. Top with the bitters and serve.
ba-tonic-rickey.description: This simple non-alcoholic Tonic Rickey from cocktail blogger Camille Wilson combines lime juice, simple syrup, tonic water, seltzer water, and Angostura bitters.

ba-tonico-di-corte.method_text:
1. Add tonic, Italicus, and gin to a highball glass filled with ice
2. Top with soda water and stir
ba-tonico-di-corte.description: Put a little dinamismo in your G&T!

ba-toronto.method_text:
1. Combine the rye whiskey, Fernet-Branca, syrup and bitters in a cocktail mixing glass (or any other type of glass).
2. Fill the mixing glass with 1 handful ice and stir continuously for 30 seconds.
3. Strain into a glass.
ba-toronto.description:
This flavorful Toronto cocktail combines the depth and warmth of whiskey with the intrigue of herbal Fernet-Branca liqueur.

A recipe for the Fernet Cocktail calling for equal parts fernet and either cognac or rye whiskey was first printed in Robert Vermeire's 1922 Cocktails: How to Mix Them with the addendum that "this cocktail is much appreciated by the Canadians of Toronto."
ba-toronto.garnish: Garnish with an orange peel and serve.

ba-trader-vics-sour.method_text:
1. In a cocktail shaker, add all ingredients
2. Shake with ice for 10-12 seconds
3. Strain over fresh ice into an old fashioned glass
ba-trader-vics-sour.description: Trader Vic created countless variations on the sour. This interpretation calls for Scotch as the choice of spirit and orgeat as the sweetener, bringing it closer to the tiki realm.
ba-trader-vics-sour.garnish: Garnish with a lemon wheel and an orchid

ba-tradewinds-negroni.method_text: Add sweet vermouth, Cointreau, and Angostura bitters to a mixing glass and fill with ice. Stir until well chilled, about 25 seconds. Strain into an Old Fashioned glass with a large ice cube. Express orange oils from twist over drink, garnish with twist, and serve.
ba-tradewinds-negroni.description: Justin Elliott of The Townsend in Austin created this spicy variation on the Negroni using equal parts sweet vermouth, Cointreau, and Angostura bitters. That's right: It's a lot of Angostura bitters.

ba-trasatlantico-fizz.method_text:
1. Combine all of the ingredients, except the club soda, in a shaker and shake hard for 10 seconds without ice.
2. Add ice and shake again for another 10 seconds.
3. Strain into a glass over ice and top with club soda.
4. Garnish.
ba-trasatlantico-fizz.description: World-renowned bar and Imbibe 75 Place to Watch, Florería Atlántico in Buenos Aires, combines winter citrus in a bright and easy-drinking gin fizz. The cocktail, created in 2013 for the bar's opening menu, "is a tribute to the immigration that came crossing the Atlantic by boat to the port of Buenos Aires," says drink creator Renato Giovannoni.
ba-trasatlantico-fizz.garnish: Orange wedge and spritz of peated scotch

ba-treacle.method_text:
1. Build in a double rocks glass filled with ice.
2. Float cloudy apple juice on top.
ba-treacle.description: One of the simplest of Bradsell’s inventions to have found lasting popularity, this is an Old-Fashioned variation. An inventive use of rum for the time. Bradsell preferred rum in this drink is Myers, and he advocated for cheap, store brand apple juice, such at Mott’s, not the fresh-pressed apple juice young mixologists sometimes opted for, thinking they were improving the drink. More popular in the UK than in the U.S., where it is rarely seen. The drink’s exact place and year of birth are unknown.

ba-tropical-popsicle.method_text:
1. Add all ingredients, except soda water, to a cocktail shaker
2. Add ice and shake hard for 10 seconds
3. Strain into a highball glass filled with cubed ice
4. Top with club soda
ba-tropical-popsicle.description: A Japanese Whisky collins, with acidity, bitter notes and tropical flavors for a pop!

ba-tropical-storm.method_text:
1. Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker 
2. Add ice and shake for 10 seconds
3. Strain into a chilled glass
ba-tropical-storm.description: Passionfruit Syrup and dark rum shine in this daiquiri-hurricane hybrid.

ba-truly-scrumptious.method_text: Shake all of the ingredients with ice, then strain into a glass holding a single large ice cube. Garnish.
ba-truly-scrumptious.description: Pear eau de vie and unaged South American grape brandy combine their fragrant forces in this luscious cocktail.

ba-tunnel.method_text:
1. Stir all ingredients until chilled in a mixing glass filled with ice.
2. Strain into a coupe.
ba-tunnel.description: This recipe for the Tunnel is a Negroni-like drink from Paris bar Cravan. It combines gin, Campari and two types of vermouth.

ba-turf-club.method_text:
1. Add the gin, dry vermouth, maraschino, absinthe, and bitters into a mixing glass with ice and stir until well-chilled.
2. Strain into a chilled coupe glass.
3. Garnish with a lemon twist.
ba-turf-club.description: This Martini variation is a complex rendition of the classic made with absinthe and maraschino liqueur.

ba-twelve-mile-limit.method_text:
1. In a cocktail shaker, add all the ingredients
2. Shake with ice for 10-12 seconds
3. Double strain into a chilled coupe
4. Garnish with a twist of lemon
ba-twelve-mile-limit.description: During the 18th century the US territorial waters were limited to 3 nautical miles. Throughout Prohibition it was legal to supply alcohol outside of these waters so parties hosted out at sea were common. This 3 mile limitation was later extended to 12 miles which led to the name inspiration for this Prohibition-era drink featuring grenadine.

ba-ultima-palabra.method_text: 1. SHAKE all ingredients with ice and fine strain into chilled glass
ba-ultima-palabra.description: Named after the direct Spanish translation of Last Word, hence the use of mezcal in place of the gin in a classic Last Word cocktail. Pineapple juice, another distinguishing feature of this riff on the classic, works brilliantly – adding a fruity sweetness and complexity.

ba-ume-paloma.method_text:
1. If using, rim a highball glass with sea salt.
2. Fill the glass with ice cubes.
3. Add the club soda first, then the other ingredients.
4. Stir gently to blend.
ba-ume-paloma.description: The Ume Paloma is a highball cocktail recipe combining blanco tequila, umeshu, pink grapefruit juice, lime juice and club soda.

ba-valkyrie.method_text: Stir with ice and strain into a rocks glass.
ba-valkyrie.description: After the Snake in the Grass at Temple Bar, bartender Sam Gabrielli wanted to showcase a drink he created called the Valkyrie. Sam described how he was influenced by Evan Harrison's Peralta with its rye, Cynar, and grapefruit elements.
ba-valkyrie.garnish: Twist a grapefruit peel over the top and discard

ba-verte-chaud.method_text:
1. Stir together hot water and shaved chocolate until combined
2. Add Chartreuse and top with wet cream
ba-verte-chaud.description: An après-ski staple perfect for the chilly chartreuse fan

ba-vieille-place.method_text: Stir all ingredients with ice and strain into an ice-filled glass
ba-vieille-place.description: A twist on the classic Vieux Carré,  the Vieille Place is a balanced, yet spirit-forward, bittersweet aperitif. Created by Robbie Neskens at Bruut in Hassselt , Belgium, this drink incorporates Bourbon, Suze, Cognac, Dry Vermouth, Simple Syrup, a dash of Amaretto, aswell as both a dash of Peychard & Angostura Bitters.

ba-vitamin-parade.method_text:
1. Combine the carrot juice, pineapple juice, lemon juice, syrup, and egg white in a shaker.
2. Dry-shake with no ice for 15–20 seconds until foam forms.
3. Add ice and shake. Fine-strain into a fizz glass.
4. Top with ginger beer.
5. Express a lemon twist over cocktail then discard.
ba-vitamin-parade.description: Natasha David combines fresh carrot and pineapple juices, citrus, ginger beer, and cinnamon syrup for this feel-good spirit-free drink.

ba-ward-eight.method_text: Shake ingredients with ice and strain into a chilled glass. Add an ice cube and a splash of sparkling water.
ba-ward-eight.description: The Ward Eight cocktail is a relative of the Whiskey Sour and thought to have been invented at Boston’s Locke-Ober Café in 1898.

ba-wardman-park.method_text:
1. Stir with ice.
2. Strain into a cocktail glass.

ba-washingtons-mule.method_text:
1. Combine syrup, brandy, lime juice, and bitters with ice in a cocktail shaker for a short shake. 
2. Strain over ice into a highball glass.
3. Top with soda water and stir.
ba-washingtons-mule.description: An autumnal and all-American version of the Moscow Mule.

ba-whiskey-apple-highball.method_text:
1. Build in a highball filled with ice.
2. Stir.
ba-whiskey-apple-highball.description: It isn’t plausible to say one bar invented such a simple highball. But Shady Pines Saloon in Sydney, and later The Baxter Inn in the same city—both owned by the same team, including Anton Forte and Jason Scott—certainly perfected and popularized this unusual highball. Shady Pines, a Western-themed bar, has a whiskey focus. After a while, the owners began to pair that whiskey with freshly squeezed green apple juice, using a Breville juicer. The novel combination was a hit with the public immediately, partly due to its eye-catching, vivid-green color. The drink never really had a proper name and it wasn’t on the menu. (Forte calls it “Whiskey Apple.”) People just knew it was available and ordered it. Soon bars across Sydney were serving the drink. Beginning in 2017, the highball hopped the Pacific and began showing up on menus at New York cocktail bars like Diamond Reef, The Suffolk Arms and Peppi’s Cellar (opened by Scott himself). That the Granny Smith apples are of good quality and are freshly juiced is vital to the success of the drink. The original whiskey used at the beginning was Jim Beam Rye, but many other ryes works just as well.

ba-whiskey-business.method_text:
1. Combine all ingredients in a mixing tin and shake with ice.
2. Strain into a glass over a ice.
3. Garnish with lemon wheel dusted in ancho chile powder.
ba-whiskey-business.description: The Whiskey Business cocktail recipe is Meaghan Dorman's spicy riff on a Whiskey Sour featuring chile liqueur and cinnamon syrup.
ba-whiskey-business.garnish: lemon wheel dusted in ancho chile powder

ba-whiskey-peach-smash.method_text:
1. Muddle the fruit and lemon wedges with the Curaçao.
2. Add the mint leaves and the bourbon.
3. Shake well and strain into a double rocks glass filled with ice.
ba-whiskey-peach-smash.description: A riff on the OG Whiskey Smash, Dale DeGroff's Whiskey Peach Smash recipe adds fresh fruit and citrus to energize the classic formula.
ba-whiskey-peach-smash.garnish: Garnish with a peach slice and a mint sprig

ba-whiskey-smash.method_text:
1. In a rocks glass, gently muddle mint with simple syrup to release oils.
2. Add lemon pieces and muddle to release juice.
3. Add crushed ice or small ice cubes and pour bourbon over.
4. Swizzle gently to mix.
5. Garnish with a mint spring and lemon wheel.
ba-whiskey-smash.description: A riff on the Mint Julep, the Whiskey Smash cocktail recipe features lemon and mint, making it a potent number dangerously easy to toss back.

ba-whisky-highball.method_text:
1. Cut a lemon ready for garnishing and squeezing
2. Fill your highball with ice
3. Pour all the ingredients into your glass
4. Top up with soda water
5. Stir the drink gently together, mixing all the ingredients
6. Garnish with the lemon wedge
ba-whisky-highball.description: Initially, the most common highball was made with Scotch whisky and carbonated water, known simply as a "Scotch and soda". New York barman Patrick Duffy claimed the highball was brought to the U.S. in 1894 from England by actor E. J. Ratcliffe. Bartender Tip:Simple and refreshing cocktail with surprising complexity. One part whisky, two parts mixer, garnished with a lemon wedge and served over ice in a highball glass; the whisky highball is as simple as it is delicious

ingredients.name: Domaine La Bohème Gentiane Extra Bitter Aperitif

ba-white-mezcal-negroni.method_text:
1. Combine in a mixing glass with ice and stir briefly for five seconds.
2. Strain into a rocks glass over a large ice cube or whatever ice you have.
3. Garnish with a lemon twist expressed over the drink, then discarded.
ba-white-mezcal-negroni.description: This White Negroni cocktail recipe swaps gin for mezcal and the expected Suze for Domaine La Bohème Gentiane Extra Bitter Aperitif.

ba-white-negroni.method_text:
1. Combine all ingredients with ice and stir
2. Strain into a lowball glass
ba-white-negroni.description: The White Negroni is a fabulous use of the gentian's powers, and a downright brilliant twist on a bonafide classic. All of the flavor components of a classic Negroni are present, but only the gin remains verbatim.

ba-white-negroni-corpse-revived.description:
We went nearly a century before a handful of rowdy boozehounds in NYC decided the Negroni needed more gin and less of everything else, but it took less than a decade for those same bartenders to tinker with Collins' White Negroni. I think that was a mistake. 

While a classic Negroni can very easily handle an increase in gin to punch through the Campari and sweet red vermouth, there is far less sugar for the gin to fight in a White Negroni, rendering an increase of gin unnecessary and oftentimes detrimental. 

The best version of this cocktail then, in my opinion, adheres to the original Negroni format, stays true to the original White Negroni flavor profile, and improves upon the original.

ba-white-negroni-sbagliato.method_text:
1. Build over a large cube in a double Old-Fashioned glass.
2. Garnish with a long slice of cucumber and a twist of orange zest.
ba-white-negroni-sbagliato.description: This White Negroni Sbagliato recipe by Brooklyn's Long Island Bar mixes herbal Suze and bianco vermouth for a summer to fall spritz.

ba-white-russian-gus-sip-and-dip.method_text:
1. Put a glass in the freezer for at least 30 minutes before preparing the cocktail. Combine the vodka, coffee liqueur, coffee, and vanilla syrup with ice and shake to chill, then set aside.
2. Fill the chilled glass with large ice cubes. Add the foam cream to the bottom of the glass over ice, filling a 1/3 of the glass. Carefully pour the prepared cocktail base over the foam cream for a rich, layered presentation.
3. Foam CreamCombine 8 parts of heavy cream with 1 part of simple syrup (1:1)  in a shaker. Shake until thickened but still pourable.
ba-white-russian-gus-sip-and-dip.description: Fans of the White Russian will love this richer, creamier take on the classic coffee cocktail. Partner Kevin Beary and Bar Manager Scott Kitsmiller of Gus' Sip and Dip in Chicago back up the traditional coffee liqueur with cold-brew coffee and vanilla syrup for balanced depth. And instead of a straight dose of heavy cream, it's shaken with simple syrup to up the decadence even more.

ba-whitechapel-gt.method_text: 1. Combine the first 3 ingredients in an ice-filled highball glass and top with chilled tonic, to taste; stir to combine, then garnish.
ba-whitechapel-gt.description: While developing a Gin & Tonic menu for gin-focused bar Whitechapel, co-owner and beverage director Alex Smith looked to Italian flavors for inspiration—and wound up with a hybrid that evokes another gin-based classic. “I was thinking about how best to capture the signature flavors of Italian spirits,” Smith says. “The two classic Negroni ingredients, vermouth and Campari, seemed almost too poetically perfect for this application—but the resulting drink is quite delicious as it turns out.”

ba-wildest-redhead.method_text:
1. Add the first four ingredients to a shaker and shake with ice.
2. Strain over a large ice cube into a rocks glass.
3. Slowly pour the Cherry Heering over the ice so that it sinks to the bottom of the drink.
ba-wildest-redhead.description: This easy whiskey cocktail recipe combines blended Scotch whisky, allspice or pimento dram, Cherry Heering, lemon and honey syrup.

ba-winterized-negroni.method_text:
1. Combine all ingredients in a mixing glass with ice.
2. Stir until chilled.
3. Strain into a coupe glass.
ba-winterized-negroni.description: A half-teaspoon of Islay Scotch brings robust and malty flavors to the Negroni for a winterized take on the aperitivo classic.

ba-wisconsin-old-fashioned.method_text:
1. In a chilled old fashioned glass, muddle the sugar, bitters, orange wedge and cherry into a thick paste, careful not to overwork the orange peel.
2. Add brandy or Cognac and stir.
3. Fill glass with crushed ice and serve.
ba-wisconsin-old-fashioned.description:
The Wisconsin Old Fashioned is the state’s variation on the classic Old Fashioned cocktail, with brandy and lemon lime soda. The typical Old Fashioned recipe uses bourbon mixed with a muddled sugar cube and bitters. So where did the brandy Old Fashioned come from?


Here’s the theory! (Per Jerry Minnich, at least.) A company of brothers debuted their Korbel brandy at the World’s Fair in 1893 in Chicago, which lots of Wisconsinites attended. A large percentage of Wisconsin at the time was German, and Germans preferred brandy over bourbon. Korbel brandy become a hit, and birthed this state’s funky variation on the classic cocktail. To this day, the drink is often served with Korbel brandy!


- Sweet: Lemon lime soda (like 7 Up or Sprite). This is the default option at bars.
- Sour: Sour mix or grapefruit soda (like Squirt).
- Press: 50/50 lemon lime soda and soda water (club soda)
- Soda: Soda water

ba-wiz-fizz.method_text:
1. Fill a highball glass 1/5 full with root beer and set aside.
2. Combine the remaining ingredients, except the cream, in a mixing tin and dry shake without ice.
3. Add the cream and dry shake again.
4. Add ice and shake again for 30 to 40 seconds.
5. Strain the ice out of the shaker and dry shake once more for 1 minute.
6. Pour the contents of the shaker into the highball glass and allow to settle before adding a final topper.
ba-wiz-fizz.description: In this fizzy cocktail recipe, gin, Cynar, lemon, and vanilla syrup act as a base, while egg white and heavy cream combine for a rich body.
ba-wiz-fizz.garnish: Garnish with grated nutmeg and a straw.

ba-wray-and-ting.method_text:
1. Add ice to a collins glass.
2. Measure in the rum.
3. Top with Ting and garnish if you'd like.
ba-wray-and-ting.description: Wray and Ting is a simple highball cocktail made with delicious overproof Jamaican rum and a refreshing grapefruit soda. Perfect for summer cookouts.

ba-yellow.method_text:
1. Combine the ingredients in a cocktail shaker with ice and shake until chilled.
2. Double-strain into a chilled coupe or cocktail glass.
3. Express the lemon twists over the surface of the drink and discard.
ba-yellow.description: The Yellow is a cocktail recipe combining London dry gin, yellow Chartreuse, Suze and lemon juice in a Last Word-like drink.

ba-your-mothers-spritz.method_text: 1. Add the ingredients, except the grapefruit soda, to a wine glass over ice. Top with the soda. Garnish.
ba-your-mothers-spritz.description: The white wine spritzer, popularized by "ladies who lunch" during the '50s, gets reimagined through a modern lens. While the original simply called for chilled white wine and club soda, this version is "punchier, brighter, and far from basic, thanks to citrus-forward Italicus, with notes of bergamot and grapefruit that round it out beautifully," says Mary Jones, the director of entertainment and nightlife for Virgin Hotels.

ba-yuzu-negroni.method_text: 1. Add all the ingredients to a mixing glass with ice. Stir to chill and strain into the glass over a large ice cube. Express with a lemon peel and garnish.
ba-yuzu-negroni.description: At Hong Kong's Bar Leone (named 50 Best Bars' best bar in Asia and Spirited Awards' Best International Bar) the yuzu Negroni is one of the most ordered cocktails. For his take on the White Negroni, the bar's owner Lorenzo Antinori introduces yuzu sake to brighten up the bitter classic with citrus and floral notes.

ba-zombie-apocalypse.method_text:
1. Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker
2. Add a small amount of ice and shake until chilled
3. Strain over crushed ice into a chilled glass
ba-zombie-apocalypse.description: A spooky, autumnal zombie riff that's perfect for a Halloween night! We added activated charcoal, which has hardly any taste, to produce the black color.

ba-zombie-spritz.method_text:
1. Combine all ingredients, except the Cava rosé, in a mixing tin and shake with ice.
2. Strain into a goblet or tiki mug over crushed ice
3. Top with cava rosé.
ba-zombie-spritz.description: At Dante's, this low-ABV spritz tangles with the Zombie's famously layered build for a cocktail recipe that feels firmly rooted to both.
ba-zombie-spritz.garnish: dehydrated grapefruit slice, fresh mint, cocktail umbrella (optional)

cat1-bay-breeze.method_text: Build in a highball/Collins glass over ice; stir; garnish with a lime wedge.

cat1-blue-hawaiian.method_text: Shake with ice; strain into a hurricane glass; garnish with a pineapple wedge and a maraschino cherry.
cat1-blue-hawaiian.description: Harry Yee, Hilton Hawaiian Village, 威基基，1957年。
cat1-blue-hawaiian.garnish: 菠萝角＋马拉斯奇诺樱桃

cat1-bobby-burns.method_text: Stir with ice; strain into a coupe/cocktail glass; garnish with a lemon twist.

cat1-cadillac-margarita.method_text: Shake tequila, lime juice, half the Grand Marnier and agave syrup with ice; strain into a salt-rimmed glass; float the remaining Grand Marnier on top.
cat1-cadillac-margarita.description: 1980年代高级版玛格丽特，起源有争议、无单一命名创作者，故归经典类。

cat1-cape-codder.method_text: Build in a highball glass over ice; stir; garnish with a lime wheel.

cat1-electric-lemonade.method_text: Shake vodka, blue curaçao and lemonade with ice; strain over ice into a highball glass; top with soda; garnish with a lemon wheel.

cat1-fog-cutter.method_text: Shake all except sherry with ice; strain into a Collins/tiki mug over crushed ice; float sherry on top.

cat1-fuzzy-navel.method_text: Build in a highball glass over ice; stir; garnish with an orange slice.

cat1-improved-whiskey-cocktail.method_text: Stir with ice; strain into an old-fashioned glass; garnish with a lemon peel.
cat1-improved-whiskey-cocktail.description: Jerry Thomas 1876年；现代规格用 Wondrich 版。

cat1-jet-pilot.method_text: Blend with crushed ice; pour into a double rocks glass; garnish with cherry and cinnamon.
cat1-jet-pilot.description: Steven Crane, Luau Beverly Hills, 1958年；Donn Beach 1941年 Test Pilot 的变奏。

cat1-long-beach-iced-tea.method_text: Shake with ice; strain into a highball glass over ice; garnish with a lemon wedge.

cat1-madras.method_text: Build in a highball glass over ice; stir; garnish with a lime or orange slice.

cat1-mudslide.method_text: Shake with ice; strain into an old-fashioned/rocks glass; chocolate syrup drizzle optional.
cat1-mudslide.description: 起源：Wreck Bar, Rum Point Club, 大开曼岛，1970年代（调酒师 Byron Tibor，由 White Russian 去淡奶油改 Baileys 而来）。

cat1-rob-roy.method_text: Stir with ice; strain into a coupe glass; garnish with a maraschino cherry (or a lemon twist).
cat1-rob-roy.garnish: 马拉斯奇诺樱桃（或柠檬 twist）

cat1-scorpion.method_text: Blend with shaved ice; pour into a tiki mug or grapefruit supreme glass; garnish with gardenia or orange.

cat1-test-pilot.method_text: Blend with crushed ice; pour into a double old-fashioned glass; garnish with a cherry.

cat1-tokyo-tea.method_text: Build in a highball glass over ice; stir; garnish with a cherry.

cat1-woo-woo.method_text: Shake with ice; strain into a highball glass over ice; garnish with a lime wedge.

cat2-amelia.method_text: Shake all ingredients with ice; fine strain into a chilled coupe/cocktail glass; garnish with a mint sprig (slapped between the palms).
cat2-amelia.description: 纽约 Employees Only 招牌，出自《Speakeasy: Classic Cocktails Reimagined》（Jason Kosmas 与 Dushan Zaric），以 Amelia Earhart 命名，常被称作 Cosmopolitan 的续作。

cat2-coastal-grooves.method_text: Muddle the citrus and falernum syrup in a shaker or mixing glass; add the wine and stir or swirl just enough to mix; dump into a tall glass and top with crushed or pebble ice; stir to integrate; garnish in cobbler fashion with fresh mint and citrus slices.
cat2-coastal-grooves.description: Dan Greenbaum, 布鲁克林 Diamond Reef 酒吧（已停业）构想的冬季 cobbler；柑橘 encouraged experimentation（蜜柑、克莱门氏小柑橘、卡拉卡拉橙均可）。

cat2-connaught-martini.method_text: Coat the rim of a frozen martini glass with bitters (dropper). Stir spirit and vermouth over ice in a mixing glass; strain from a height into the prepared glass; garnish with a lemon twist or a green olive.
cat2-connaught-martini.description: 伦敦 The Connaught Bar 招牌马天尼，Agostino Perrone；自家苦精有薰衣草、豆蔻、姜、零陵香豆、佛手柑等可选。
cat2-connaught-martini.garnish: 柠檬 twist 或绿橄榄

cat2-ginger-smash.method_text: Muddle the lemon wedges and ginger syrup in a shaker; add mint and bourbon; shake with ice; fine-strain into a lowball/rocks glass over ice; garnish with a mint sprig.
cat2-ginger-smash.description: 通用姜味威士忌 Smash（多站一致版本）。

cat2-king-kong.method_text: Stir with ice; strain into an old-fashioned glass over ice; garnish with a lemon twist.
cat2-king-kong.description: Sam Ross, 纽约 Attaboy 酒吧，2015年。

cat2-midnight-stinger.method_text: Shake with ice; strain into an old-fashioned glass over crushed ice.
cat2-midnight-stinger.description: Sam Ross, 纽约 Attaboy 酒吧。

cat2-ready-fire-aim.method_text: Shake with ice; double-strain into a chilled coupe; garnish with a grind of pink peppercorn.
cat2-ready-fire-aim.description: 纽约 Employees Only，创作者 Steve Schneider。蜂蜜菠萝糖浆做法：蜂蜜2杯＋热水1杯调匀，另捣碎50粒粉红胡椒与一整只切块菠萝，混合静置过夜后滤出，冷藏可存一周。

cat3-bensonhurst.method_text: Stir with ice; strain into a Nick & Nora/coupe glass; no garnish (or a cherry).
cat3-bensonhurst.description: Chad Solomon, 纽约 Milk & Honey / Pegu Club，2006年。

cat3-fitzgerald.method_text: Shake with ice; strain into a rocks glass over ice; garnish with a lemon wheel or twist.
cat3-fitzgerald.description: Dale DeGroff, 纽约 Rainbow Room，1990年代初；原名 Gin Thing，后改名 Fitzgerald。

cat4-dont-mention-the-war.method_text: Muddle 10 basil leaves in maraschino. Add other liquid ingredients and stir with ice. Double strain, up, garnish.
cat4-dont-mention-the-war.description: Craig Eliason, 明尼苏达圣保罗；Reddit 原创鸡尾酒大赛 2026年10月冠军（主题：罗勒与水果白兰地），立意为黑森林蛋糕的巧克力与樱桃风味、由草本罗勒与辛辣金酒拉回不致过甜。
cat4-dont-mention-the-war.glass: coupé杯（推断：来源做法写 double strain up，未明示杯名）

cat4-mezcal-me-maybe.method_text: Stir, strain, up, garnish if desired. Can also be served as a shot.
cat4-mezcal-me-maybe.description: Reddit 用户 Duffuser；为 Reddit Tipple Tuesday #5 挑战（双原料鸡尾酒）而作。
cat4-mezcal-me-maybe.glass: coupé杯（推断：来源做法写 up，未明示杯名）

cat4-my-favorite-mutiny.method_text: Whip shake with crushed ice, pour into a mug, fill with more crushed ice, and garnish with freshly grated nutmeg.
cat4-my-favorite-mutiny.description: Frederic Yarm, 马萨诸塞萨默维尔；作者原创（Kindred Cocktails），Jet Pilot 变奏方向；灵感来自 Trina’s Starlite Lounge 的 Wagon Wheel Watusi（黑麦、Smith & Cross、班尼迪克特、可可利口酒、青柠），名字取自 The Coup 2006年歌曲。

cat4-san-buena-ventura.method_text: Stir ingredients over ice and strain into a chilled tumbler over a large rock. Express the orange twist and drop it in the drink.

cat4-sidewinds.method_text: Whip shake with crushed ice, pour into a mug, top with crushed ice, and garnish with mint sprigs.
cat4-sidewinds.description: Frederic Yarm, 马萨诸塞萨默维尔；作者原创（Kindred Cocktails＋作者博客 cocktailvirgin），自述为经典 Tradewinds 的苦味 funky 变奏（原想做 Fernet-Campari 的 Ferrari 变奏，味道太混后去掉 Fernet、回归朗姆主导）。

cat5-arnold-palmer.method_text: Build in a highball glass over ice; stir; garnish with a lemon slice.
cat5-arnold-palmer.description: 以高尔夫球手 Arnold Palmer 命名。

cat5-cinderella.method_text: Shake juices and grenadine with ice; strain over ice into a Collins/highball glass; top with ginger ale or club soda; garnish with an orange slice and a pineapple wedge.

cat5-roy-rogers.method_text: Build in a highball/Collins glass over ice; stir gently; garnish with a maraschino cherry.
cat5-roy-rogers.description: 以歌手兼演员 Roy Rogers 命名的独立无酒精经典。

cat6-baijiu-basil-smash.method_text: Place lemons and basil in a cocktail shaker and press with a muddler to extract juices and oils from the lemon and crush the basil. Add remaining ingredients to the shaker with ice. Seal the shaker and shake hard. Once chilled, strain the drink through a fine strainer into a rocks glass over cubed ice. Garnish with a lemon wedge and basil leaves.
cat6-baijiu-basil-smash.description: Good Spirits Co.；配餐建议：地中海菜（烤鱼、希腊沙拉、披萨）。

cat6-baijiu-chuhai.method_text: Fill a highball glass about halfway with ice cubes, then add the shochu, Calpico, baijiu, Midori, and lemon juice. Stir well, top with soda water, garnish with mint leaves, and serve.
cat6-baijiu-chuhai.description: 芝加哥 Nine Bar，联合老板 Lily Wang 与饮料总监 Joe Briglio；灵感来自日本 chuhai（烧酒 highball）与蜜瓜汽水；作者喜欢用明 river（泸州老窖产，有菠萝底韵）。

cat6-baijiu-falls.method_text: Shake all ingredients together in a cocktail shaker. Strain into a lowball glass over ice. Garnish with apple slices.
cat6-baijiu-falls.description: 来源 drinkbaijiu.com（经 Seekonk Liquors 博客转引）。

cat6-baijiu-mac.method_text: Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker with ice. Seal and shake hard. Once chilled, open shaker and strain through a fine strainer into a rocks glass over cubed ice. Garnish with a pear fan.

cat6-baijiu-mule.method_text: In a glass, add ice, baijiu, and lime juice. Top with ginger beer and stir gently. Garnish with a lime wedge or mint sprig.
cat6-baijiu-mule.glass: 高球杯（推断，来源仅写 in a glass）

cat6-baijiu-negroni.method_text: Stir all ingredients in a mixing glass with ice until well-chilled. Strain into a glass with a large ice cube and garnish with an orange peel.
cat6-baijiu-negroni.description: OMGCheers：经典 Negroni 的白酒变奏（酱香白酒代金酒）。
cat6-baijiu-negroni.glass: 老式杯（推断，来源仅写 with a large ice cube）

cat6-baijiu-old-fashioned.method_text: Stir the baijiu, simple syrup, and bitters in a mixing glass with ice until well-chilled. Strain into a glass over a large ice cube and garnish with an orange peel.
cat6-baijiu-old-fashioned.description: OMGCheers：威士忌 Old Fashioned 的白酒变奏。
cat6-baijiu-old-fashioned.glass: 老式杯（推断，来源仅写 over a large ice cube）

cat6-baijiu-pina-koala.method_text: Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker with ice. Seal the shaker and shake hard. Once chilled, strain over crushed ice into a tall glass. Garnish with a pineapple wedge and a cocktail umbrella.
cat6-baijiu-pina-koala.description: Good Spirits Co.；Piña Colada 的白酒变奏。

cat6-baijiu-sour.method_text: In a shaker, combine the baijiu, lemon juice, and simple syrup. If using egg white, dry shake (without ice) first to froth, then add ice and shake again. Strain into a glass and garnish with a lemon twist.
cat6-baijiu-sour.glass: coupé杯（推断，来源仅写 strain into a glass）

cat6-baijiu-tai.method_text: Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker with ice. Seal shaker and shake hard. Once chilled, strain the cocktail over cubed ice in a rocks glass. Cap the cocktail with crushed ice and dash bitters over ice. Garnish with a mint sprig and orange wedge.
cat6-baijiu-tai.description: Good Spirits Co. 首席调酒师 Joseph Sinagra 创作；灵感来自珀斯海滩，适合炎热晴天。

cat6-baijiu-tonic.method_text: In a highball glass, add ice, baijiu, and lime juice. Top off with tonic water. Stir to mix. Garnish with lime wedge.

cat6-beautiful-baijiu-pear.method_text: In a cocktail shaker, add vodka, pear nectar, baijiu, and elderflower liqueur. Shake to chill. Strain into rocks glass over fresh ice. Garnish with pear slice, if desired.
cat6-beautiful-baijiu-pear.description: LoveToKnow 白酒指南；建议用清香型白酒，若无可用梨味伏特加＋少许糖浆缓和。

cat6-clean-cut.method_text: Add all ingredients to a mixing glass with ice. Stir to mix, chill and dilute. Once chilled and diluted to taste, strain into a mezcal rinsed chilled cocktail glass.
cat6-clean-cut.description: Good Spirits Co.；配餐建议：鱼子酱、黄油煎鱼、奶油意面、咖喱或四川花椒牛肉等重口味菜。

cat6-flowers-by-the-sea.method_text: Add all to a mixing glass with ice. Stir and strain into a rocks glass over a large cube of ice. Garnish with nori sheets.
cat6-flowers-by-the-sea.description: Good Spirits Co.；海苔茉莉味美思做法：500ml干型味美思＋2张海苔＋50g茉莉茶，浸泡过夜后细滤装瓶。

cat6-golden-years.method_text: Combine all ingredients into a cocktail pitcher or mixing glass. Add ice. Stir and strain into a rocks glass over a large ice cube.
cat6-golden-years.description: 来源 Punch 杂志（经 cocktailsand.substack 转述）；米香型白酒在美国不易买到，作者在西雅图只找到红星二锅头（低香型）作替代的说明已注明。

cat6-last-emperor.method_text: Make the infused baijiu: add baijiu and 0.25oz whole oolong tea leaves to a 1-quart jar, seal, and steep at room temperature 4–12 hours. To a shaker filled halfway with ice, add 1.5oz infused baijiu, umeshu, egg white, lime juice, pineapple juice and simple syrup. Shake until chilled, about 15 seconds, then strain into a coupe or rocks glass. Discard the ice, pour the liquid back into the shaker, and shake again until foamy, about 15 seconds more. Strain back into the glass, garnish with a dehydrated pineapple slice if desired.
cat6-last-emperor.description: 纽约皇后区 929 酒吧，创始人 Haoran Chen；威士忌酸变奏（金门高粱代波本）；名字取自 Anita Mui 1988年歌曲《Drunk in Dreams Together》（采样《末代皇帝》主题曲）。

cat6-lost-plate-baijiu-cocktail.method_text: Combine Baijiu, lime juice, Ginger Portland Syrup, and cinnamon anise simple syrup in a shaker. (Full directions truncated in fetch; ginger-ale substitution note: If no ginger syrup, replace syrup and soda water with ginger ale.)
cat6-lost-plate-baijiu-cocktail.description: Lost Plate 白酒鸡尾酒礼盒主配方；自述为“中国、柬埔寨与波特兰风味一杯”。

cat6-maos-delight.method_text: Add all ingredients to a mixing glass with ice. Stir to mix, chill and dilute. Once chilled and diluted to taste, strain over a large ice cube into an absinthe rinse rocks glass. Garnish with maraschino cherries.
cat6-maos-delight.description: Good Spirits Co.；四原料、号称在家极易做。

cat6-passionfruit-tiki.method_text: Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker with ice. Shake and strain into a chilled tiki mug over cubed ice. Add crushed ice. Garnish with mint sprig, white chocolate and passionfruit pulp.
cat6-passionfruit-tiki.description: Good Spirits Co.；自述 funky、清爽、周末开场款。
cat6-passionfruit-tiki.garnish: 薄荷枝＋白巧克力＋百香果浆

cat6-plum-baijiu-fizz.method_text: Shake the baijiu, umeshu, and lime juice with ice, then strain into a glass with ice. Top with soda water and garnish with a lime wheel or fresh plum slices.
cat6-plum-baijiu-fizz.description: OMGCheers：白酒配梅子风味，突出花香与甜感，适合暖季与早午餐。
cat6-plum-baijiu-fizz.glass: 高球杯（推断，来源仅写 a glass with ice）

cat6-rhubarb-fool.method_text: Add all to a shaker and shake to combine. Add ice and shake to chill and dilute. Double strain into a chilled coupe glass. Garnish with dehydrated rhubarb.
cat6-rhubarb-fool.description: Good Spirits Co.（澳大利亚白酒）官方鸡尾酒页。

cat6-slice-of-baijiu-paradise.method_text: Combine all ingredients in a shaker. Add ice and shake vigorously for 20 seconds until cool. Strain into glass. Garnish with a pineapple wedge or star anise.
cat6-slice-of-baijiu-paradise.description: Lost Plate 白酒鸡尾酒礼盒配方；自述“完美夏日鸡尾酒”。

cat6-spicy-baijiu-cooler.method_text: In a cocktail shaker, muddle jalapeño coins and cucumber slices with simple syrup. Add ice, baijiu, and lemon juice. Shake to chill. Strain into rocks glass over fresh ice. Top off with club soda. Garnish with jalapeño coin.

cat6-strawberry-sweet.method_text: Add strawberries to a cocktail shaker and muddle until strawberries are crushed. Add remaining ingredients to the shaker with ice. Seal shaker and shake hard. Once chilled, strain through a fine strainer into a chilled cocktail glass. Garnish with a fresh strawberry.
cat6-strawberry-sweet.description: Good Spirits Co.；来源原文小写 strawberry sweet。

cat6-summer-collins.method_text: Place cucumber slices into a mixing tin and lightly muddle. Add Australian Baijiu, Eau de Vie, lime juice and simple syrup with ice. Shake and fine strain into stemless wine glass with mint leaves in the bottom. Add cubed ice and top with soda. Garnish with a mint sprig, cucumber wrap and lime wheel.

cat6-sydney-spring-punch.method_text: Add berries to a cocktail shaker and muddle until berries are all crushed. Add the rest of the ingredients to the shaker with ice except the Sparkling wine. Seal the shaker and shake hard. Once chilled, strain into a wine glass over cubed ice. Top with sparkling wine. Garnish with mixed berries (Blueberry, Blackberry and Raspberry).
cat6-sydney-spring-punch.description: Good Spirits Co.；配餐建议：开胃小食（腌肉、奶酪、泡菜）。
cat6-sydney-spring-punch.garnish: 混合莓果（蓝莓、黑莓、树莓）

cat6-tropical-baijiu.method_text: In a cocktail shaker, add ice, baijiu, pineapple juice, and simple syrup. Shake to chill. Strain into rocks glass over fresh ice. Garnish with pineapple wedge, if desired.

cat6-wise-sage.method_text: Add all to a mixing glass with ice. Stir until chilled and diluted. Strain into a chilled martini glass. Garnish with a pineapple wedge.
cat6-wise-sage.description: Good Spirits Co. 首席调酒师 Joseph Sinagra 创作；菠萝鼠尾草糖浆做法：菠萝块500g＋细砂糖500g覆膜过夜，次日压出汁滤出糖浆，加鼠尾草10g加热后离火放凉、滤出装瓶。

cdb-11002.method_text: Combine all ingredients (except cola) and pour over ice in a highball glass. Add the splash of cola for color. Decorate with a slice of lemon and serve.

cdb-11014.method_text: Shake all ingredients with ice and strain contents into a cocktail glass. Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.

cdb-11020.method_text: Combine and shake all ingredients with ice, strain contents into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cdb-11021.method_text: Shake all ingredients (except lemon peel) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Top with the twist of lemon peel and serve.

cdb-11023.method_text: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

cdb-11046.method_text: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cdb-11055.method_text: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cdb-11060.method_text: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

cdb-11106.method_text: Stir sloe gin and vermouth with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Add the twist of lemon peel and serve.

cdb-11120.method_text: In a mixing glass half-filled with crushed ice, combine the gin, triple sec, Curacao, and bitters. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass and garnish with the lemon twist and the cherry.

cdb-11124.method_text: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, vermouth, bitters, and maraschino liqueur. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass and garnish with the cherry.

cdb-11149.method_text: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a sour glass.

cdb-11222.method_text: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cdb-11224.method_text: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a sour glass.

cdb-11239.method_text: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cdb-11242.method_text: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a highball glass over two ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.

cdb-11251.method_text: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

cdb-11255.method_text: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cdb-11320.method_text: In a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes, combine the gin and ginger ale. Stir well. Garnish with the lime wedge.

cdb-11324.method_text: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine the Scotch and vermouth. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with the lemon twist.

cdb-11326.method_text: Stir all ingredients (except lemon peel) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Add the twist of lemon peel and serve.

cdb-11338.method_text: Pour brandy, gin, and sweet vermouth into a highball glass over ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water. Add the twist of lemon peel, stir, and serve. (Ginger ale may be substituted for carbonated water, if preferred.)

cdb-11339.method_text: Rub rim of cocktail glass with lemon juice and dip rim of glass in powdered sugar. Shake all ingredients (except cherry) with ice and strain into sugar-rimmed glass. Top with the cherry and serve.

cdb-11368.method_text: In an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes, combine the gin and triple sec. Stir well.

cdb-11369.method_text: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cdb-11375.method_text: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a chilled cocktail glass, and serve.

cdb-11382.method_text: Shake all ingredients (except slices of lemon and lime) with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Decorate with the slices of lemon and lime and serve.

cdb-11387.method_text: Combine all ingredients (except for the cherry) in an electric blender and blend at a low speed for five seconds, then blend at a high speed until firm. Pour contents into a champagne flute, top with the cherry, and serve.

cdb-11390.method_text: Combine all ingredients with 1 cup of crushed ice in an electric blender. Blend at a low speed for a short length of time. Pour into an old-fashioned glass and serve.

cdb-11391.method_text: Combine all ingredients with 1 cup of crushed ice in an electric blender. Blend at a low speed for a short length of time. Pour into a cocktail glass and serve.

cdb-11407.method_text: Stir powdered sugar and 2 oz. carbonated water in a collins glass. Fill glass with ice and add gin. Fill with carbonated water and stir. Add the lemon peel and the orange spiral so that the end of the orange spiral dangles over rim of glass.

cdb-11408.method_text: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, lemon juice, sugar, and grenadine. Shake well. Pour into an old-fashioned glass and garnish with the cherry and the orange slice.

cdb-11415.method_text: Dissolve powdered sugar in mixture of water and juice of lemon. Add gin. Pour into an old-fashioned glass over ice cubes and stir. Add the twist of orange peel and serve.

cdb-11416.method_text: Muddle sugar with carbonated water and mint sprigs in an old-fashioned glass. Add gin and 1 ice cube. Stir, add the orange slice and the cherry, and serve.

cdb-11417.method_text: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, lemon juice, and sugar. Shake well. Strain into a sour glass and garnish with the orange slice and the cherry.

cdb-11418.method_text: Stir gin, grenadine, and powdered sugar with ice and strain into a highball glass over ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water and stir. Decorate with the pineapple chunks and the strawberries and serve.

cdb-11419.method_text: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the lime juice, sugar, gin, and bitters. Shake well. Almost fill a colling glass with ice cubes. Stir until the glass is frosted. Strain the mixture in the shaker into the glass and add the club soda.

cdb-11420.method_text: Mix powdered sugar and water in an old-fashioned glass. Add gin and one ice cube. Stir, add the twist of lemon peel, and serve.

cdb-11422.method_text: Shake all ingredients well with cracked ice, strain into a champagne flute, and serve.

cdb-11433.method_text: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, triple sec, pineapple juice, and grenadine. Shake well. Pour into an old-fashioned glass and garnish with the pineapple slice.

cdb-11470.method_text: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

cdb-11472.method_text: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cdb-11476.method_text: Stir all ingredients (except olive) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Add the olive and serve.

cdb-11524.method_text: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a highball glass over two ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.

cdb-11528.method_text: Pour all ingredients (except orange slice and cherry) into a collins glass over ice cubes. Garnish with the slice of orange, add the cherry on top, and serve.

cdb-11542.method_text: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cdb-11558.method_text: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a highball glass over two ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.

cdb-11566.method_text: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

cdb-11580.method_text: Pour all ingredients directly into highball glass filled with ice. Stir gently. Garnish. Add a dash of Angostura bitters.

cdb-11602.method_text: Pour the bourbon and Benedictine into a brandy snifter.

cdb-11604.method_text: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes combine the courbon and Benedictine. Shake and strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with the lemon twist.

cdb-11634.method_text: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass over two ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.

cdb-11658.method_text: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine the Scotch, Drambuie, and vermouth. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with the lemon twist.

cdb-11662.method_text: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

cdb-11664.method_text: Stir ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cdb-11666.method_text: Stir powdered sugar and 2 oz. carbonated water in a collins glass. Fill glass with ice, add gin and vermouth, and stir. Fill with carbonated water and stir again. Add the twist of lemon peel and the orange spiral so that the end dangles over rim of glass.

cdb-11670.method_text: Pour the rum and Tia Maria into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well.

cdb-11798.method_text: Pour all of the ingredients into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well.

cdb-11870.method_text: Shake brandy, gin, and orange juice with ice and strain into a highball glass over ice cubes. Fill with ginger ale, stir, and serve.

cdb-11872.method_text: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a chilled cocktail glass, and serve.

cdb-11936.method_text: Pour the bitters into a wine glass. Swirl the glass to coat the inside with the bitters, shake out the excess. Pour the gin into the glass. Do not add ice.

cdb-11938.method_text: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cdb-11959.method_text: Shake ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cdb-11961.method_text: Pour carefully into a pousse-cafe glass, so that creme de menthe floats on grenadine. Serve without mixing.

cdb-11963.method_text: Stir ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cdb-11965.method_text: Shake all ingredients (except nutmeg) with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.

cdb-11983.method_text: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cdb-11985.method_text: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cdb-11987.method_text: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cdb-11989.method_text: Pour red wine and grenadine into a collins glass over ice cubes. Fill with lemon-lime soda, stir, and serve.

cdb-11991.method_text: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cdb-11993.method_text: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the rum, Kahlua, and cream. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass and garnish with the nutmeg.

cdb-12055.method_text: Shake all ingredients (except cola) with ice and strain into a chilled collins glass. Fill with cola and serve.

cdb-12057.method_text: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a highball glass over two ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.

cdb-12067.method_text: In an old-fashioned glass, dissolve the sugar in the club soda. Add crushed ice until the glass is almost full. Add the rum. Stir well. Garnish with the cherry and the orange and lemon slices.

cdb-12071.method_text: Pour the rum and soda into a collins glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well and garnish with the lemon wedge.

cdb-12087.method_text: Shake all ingredients (except nutmeg) with ice and strain into a collins glass. Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.

cdb-12089.method_text: Stir powdered sugar, water, and bitters in an old-fashioned glass. When sugar has dissolved add ice cubes and light rum. Add the twist of lime peel, float 151 proof rum on top, and serve.

cdb-12091.method_text: Pour rum into a highball glass over ice cubes. Add orange juice, stir, and serve.

cdb-12093.method_text: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the rum, lemon juice, and sugar. Shake well. Strain into a sour glass and garnish with the orange slice and the cherry.

cdb-12097.method_text: Dissolve powdered sugar in water in an old-fashioned glass. Add rum and one ice cube and stir. Add the twist of lemon peel and serve.

cdb-12107.method_text: Pour all ingredients over ice cubes in a highball glass. Stir well and serve. (Vodka may be substituted for gin, if preferred.)

cdb-12130.method_text: Shake all ingredients well with cracked ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cdb-12158.method_text: Shake scotch, juice of lime, and powdered sugar with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Decorate with 1/2 slice lemon, top with the cherry, and serve.

cdb-12188.method_text: Shake sherry, powdered sugar, and egg with ice and strain into a collins glass. Fill with milk and stir. Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.

cdb-12190.method_text: Shake all ingredients (except nutmeg) with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.

cdb-12256.method_text: Shake ingredients with ice, strain into a brandy snifter, and serve. (The English translation of the name of this drink is "Sun and Shade", and after sampling this drink, you'll understand why. Thanks, Kirby.)

cdb-12308.method_text: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a chilled whiskey sour glass, and serve.

cdb-12362.method_text: Shake all ingredients (except ginger ale) with ice and strain into a collins glass over ice cubes. Fill with ginger ale, stir, and serve.

cdb-12370.method_text: Shake tequila, juice of lemon, and powdered sugar with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Add the half-slice of lemon, top with the cherry, and serve.

cdb-12388.method_text: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

cdb-12402.method_text: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, lemon juice, and sugar. Shake well. Strain into a collins glass alomst filled with ice cubes. Add the club soda. Stir and garnish with the cherry and the orange slice.

cdb-12418.method_text: Stir all ingredients (except orange peel) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Add the twist of orange peel and serve.

cdb-12420.method_text: Stir all ingredients with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with a cherry and a twist of lemon zest.

cdb-12434.method_text: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cdb-12436.method_text: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into an old-fashioned glass over ice cubes, and serve.

cdb-12442.method_text: Stir vermouth and creme de cassis in a highball glass with ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir again, and serve.

cdb-12444.method_text: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into an old-fashioned glass over ice cubes, and serve.

It looks like dark chocolate sauce. Pour hot espresso over the honey, stirring to dissolve. Serve with cream.

cdb-12782.method_text: Place the coffee and spices in the filter cone of your coffee maker. Brew coffee as usual, let it cool. Add 5-6 ice cubes and pour coffee to within about 1 inch of the top of the glass. Rest a spoon on top of the coffee and slowly pour whipping cream into the spoon. This will make the cream float on top of the coffee rather than dispersing into it right away.

cdb-12800.method_text: Boil water and sugar until dissolved. Turn off heat. Slowly add dry instant coffee and continue stirring. Add a chopped vanilla bean to the vodka, then combine the cooled sugar syrup and coffee solution with the vodka. Cover tightly and shake vigorously each day for 3 weeks. Strain and filter. Its also best to let the sugar mixture cool completely so the vodka won't evaporate when its added. If you like a smoother feel to the liqueur you can add about 1 teaspoon of glycerine to the finished product.

cdb-12910.method_text: In a small mixer bowl beat egg yolks till blended. Gradually add 1/4 cup sugar, beating at high speed till thick and lemon colored. Gradually add remaining 1/4 cup sugar, beating to stiff peaks. Fold yolk mixture and whipped cream into egg whites. Serve immediately. Sprinkle nutmeg over each serving. Serve in a punch bowl or another big bowl. NOTE: For a nonalcoholic eggnog, prepare Eggnog as above, except omit the bourbon and rum and increase the milk to 3 cups.

Choose 1 or several of: Chocolate curls, cinnamon sticks, extracts of flavorings, flavored brandy or liqueur, fruit juice or nectar, ground nutmeg, maraschino cherries, orange slices, peppermint sticks or candy canes, plain brandy, run or whiskey, sherbet or ice-cream, whipping cream, whipped. cdb-17246.method_text:
To ensure that your pork fat is just as delicious as theirs, here’s their adobo marinade and what to do with it (you’ll also need a rack of ribs):

4 ancho chiles, 8 guajillo chiles and 4 chipotle chiles, plus 4 cloves roasted garlic, half a cup of cider vinegar, a quarter teaspoon of Mexican oregano, 1 teaspoon of ground black pepper, a whole clove, a quarter teaspoon of ground cinnamon and a half teaspoon of ground cumin.

Toast the dried chiles and soak in water for at least an hour until they are rehydrated. Drain and discard the soaking liquid. Combine the soaked chiles with the remaining ingredients and purée until smooth.

Cold smoke a rack of baby back pork ribs by taking a large hotel pan with woodchips on one side and charcoal on the other. Place another, smaller, pan with pork ribs, above the charcoal/woodchip pan. Ignite the charcoal, being careful to not ignite the woodchips. Cover both pans with foil and allow to smoke for 10-15 minutes, until desired level of smoke is achieved, then coat with adobo marinade and wrap in tin foil prior to placing ribs in a 300 degree oven for 7 hours. When the ribs have cooled, strain off the fat and use for the infusion.

If you’re having a hard time coming up to the same kind of volume of fat, make up the balance with pork lard from a butcher. To get the same depth of flavor without the ribs, heat up the fat in a pot with a few spoons of the marinade.

Once you’ve got your tub of seasoned pork fat in cooled liquid form, pour equal amounts of Ilegal Joven mezcal and fat into a sealable container. Seal the container and give it a really good shake, then put it in the freezer overnight. When the whole thing is separated and congealed, pour it through a fine mesh chinoise. If you don’t have a chinoise, try a fine mesh strainer, or if you don’t have one of those, try spooning off most of the fat. There will be some beads of orange fat left in the strained mezcal: run that through a few layers of cheesecloth (or coffee filters in a pinch) to get rid of the last of it.

The mezcal is now ready for drinking, straight-up or in a cocktail. 

Habanero tincture

Slice habaneros and add 2 ounces Ilegal Joven mezcal.
Allow to sit overnight or until desired level of heat is achieved.
Cocktail

Combine mezcal and chocolate liqueur in a mixing glass with ice and stir for 45 seconds.
Strain into chilled coupe.
Carefully "sink" the coffee liqueur down the inside of the coupe over a spoon.
Garnish with 5 drops habanero tincture.

Pour in The Irishman and Disaronno
Fill to the top with Cranberry Juice
Garnish with a slice of lemon…Enjoy!

cdb-178313.method_text:
Tip the cherry juice, orange peel, chilli, cinnamon sticks, cloves and ginger into a large saucepan. Simmer for 5 mins, then turn off the heat. Leave to cool, then chill for at least 4 hrs, or up to 2 days – the longer you leave it the more intense the flavours. If serving to young children, take the chilli out after a few hours.

When you’re ready to serve, pour the juice into a jug. Serve in glass bottles or glasses and pop a straw in each. If you're adding vodka, do so at this stage. Dangle a fangs sweet from each glass.

cdb-178315.method_text:

cdb-178322.method_text:
Gently warm 60g golden caster sugar in a pan with 30ml water and 1 tbsp allspice. Cook gently until the sugar has dissolved, then leave the mixture to cool. Strain through a sieve lined with a coffee filter (or a double layer of kitchen paper).

Pour 60ml of the spiced syrup into a cocktail shaker along with 200ml rum and 90ml lime juice. Shake with ice and strain between six flute glasses. Top up with 600ml champagne and garnish each with an orange twist.

cdb-178326.method_text: Chop the Lemon, Lime and other fruits into large chunks. Fill the Pitcher with the white wine and mix in the Apple Brandy. Top to taste with soda water.

Add ice, tequila, grapefruit juice, lime juice and top with pineapple soda.
Give it a quick stir.
Garnish with fresh pineapple or lime.

cdb-17833.method_text: Shake ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cdb-178330.method_text: Add all the spirits in a shaker (best to use Hendricks gin) as well as the orange bitters and lemon juice. Strain into a Margarita glass, top with Prosecco.

cdb-178342.method_text:

Garnish with the lime wedge.

cdb-178343.method_text:

Served In a chilled, salt-rimmed glass

Add honey vodka, lemon juice, and a large ice cube (@glacioice). Shake until well chilled, and strain into glass. Add tonic water and finally 2 dashes of angostura bitters. Garnish with sliced figs and thyme.

STEP 1

STEP 2
Add a splash of lemon juice to each, then taste and add more to your preference. Finish each with a slice of lemon, studded with a clove, and serve immediately.

cdb-178348.method_text: Everyone’s favourite Paloma gets a delicious Indian makeover. Tequila reposado infused with “Timur Pepper” which has citrusy & grapefruit notes and is grown at the foothills of Himalaya. It also produces a slightly numbing and tingling sensation on your lip when consumed. We have also spiced up the fresh grapefruit juice with the warming spice blend from Himalaya. The combination of all these interesting elements has allowed us to elevate your Paloma sipping experience.
